inspector_id FK\n uuid uav_id FK\n uuid region_id FK\n geometry boundary\n text manager_instructions\n timestamptz confirmation_deadline\n uint version\n }\n\n pre_mission_assessments {\n uuid id PK\n uuid mission_id UK,FK\n uuid manager_id FK\n varchar status\n varchar site_feasibility\n varchar weather_suitability\n varchar airspace_clearance\n varchar resource_readiness\n jsonb findings\n geometry proposed_boundary\n timestamptz evaluated_at\n }\n\n mission_targets {\n uuid id PK\n uuid mission_id FK\n uuid tower_id FK\n int sequence_order\n varchar inspection_status\n timestamptz inspected_at\n }\n\n mission_assignments {\n uuid id PK\n uuid mission_id FK\n uuid user_id FK\n varchar assignment_role\n boolean is_required\n varchar status\n varchar response_status\n timestamptz assigned_at\n timestamptz responded_at\n text response_reason\n uint version\n }\n\n resource_bookings {\n uuid id PK\n uuid mission_id FK\n uuid user_id FK\n uuid drone_id FK\n timestamptz start_at\n timestamptz end_at\n varchar status\n }\n\n drone_technical_inspections {\n uuid id PK\n uuid drone_id FK\n uuid technician_user_id FK\n varchar status\n varchar health\n timestamptz started_at\n timestamptz completed_at\n timestamptz valid_until\n jsonb raw_snapshot\n text notes\n }\n\n drone_technical_metrics {\n uuid id PK\n uuid inspection_id FK\n varchar metric_code\n varchar subsystem\n numeric numeric_value\n boolean passed\n boolean is_critical\n varchar unit\n }\n\n mission_check_ins {\n uuid id PK\n uuid mission_id FK\n uuid user_id FK\n geometry check_in_location\n timestamptz checked_in_at\n varchar status\n }\n\n drone_handovers {\n uuid id PK\n uuid mission_id FK\n uuid drone_id FK\n uuid handed_over_by FK\n uuid received_by FK\n timestamptz received_at\n jsonb initial_checklist\n varchar status\n timestamptz returned_at\n jsonb return_checklist\n }\n\n mission_flight_logs {\n uuid id PK\n uuid mission_id FK\n jsonb gps_track\n float min_battery_recorded\n float max_altitude_m\n int flight_duration_seconds\n varchar connection_status\n timestamptz recorded_at\n uuid created_by\n }\n\n incident_reports {\n uuid id PK\n uuid mission_id FK\n uuid reported_by FK\n uuid tower_id FK\n varchar incident_type\n varchar severity\n text description\n varchar file_url\n varchar status\n timestamptz reported_at\n }\n\n inspection_media {\n uuid id PK\n uuid mission_id FK\n uuid tower_id FK\n uuid uploaded_by FK\n geometry capture_location\n varchar media_type\n varchar file_url\n varchar ai_source\n varchar validation_status\n timestamptz captured_at\n }\n\n ai_analysis_requests {\n uuid id PK\n uuid media_id FK\n uuid mission_id FK\n uuid tower_id FK\n uuid uploaded_by FK\n uuid source_event_id\n varchar media_type\n varchar status\n jsonb result\n timestamptz completed_at\n timestamptz created_at\n }\n\n defect_categories {\n int id PK\n varchar category_code UK\n varchar name\n varchar default_severity\n text description\n boolean is_active\n }\n\n detected_anomalies {\n uuid id PK\n uuid media_id FK\n uuid tower_id FK\n int category_id FK\n uuid analyst_id FK\n jsonb bounding_box\n float confidence_score\n varchar validation_status\n jsonb analyst_feedback\n timestamptz validated_at\n varchar crop_url\n varchar image_url\n jsonb gps\n varchar ai_source\n }\n\n emergency_alerts {\n uuid id PK\n uuid anomaly_id FK\n uuid tower_id FK\n uuid mission_id FK\n varchar status\n varchar priority\n timestamptz triggered_at\n timestamptz resolved_at\n uuid reviewed_by_user_id FK\n text notes\n }\n\n alert_escalations {\n uuid id PK\n uuid alert_id FK\n uuid escalated_by FK\n uuid escalated_to FK\n int escalation_level\n text reason\n timestamptz escalated_at\n }\n\n maintenance_tickets {\n uuid id PK\n varchar ticket_code UK\n uuid anomaly_id FK\n uuid tower_id FK\n uuid manager_id FK\n uuid technician_id FK\n varchar status\n varchar priority\n text description\n timestamptz due_date\n timestamptz assigned_at\n timestamptz started_at\n timestamptz resolved_at\n }\n\n maintenance_proofs {\n uuid id PK\n uuid ticket_id FK\n varchar proof_type\n varchar file_url\n uuid uploaded_by FK\n timestamptz uploaded_at\n }\n\n tower_condition_histories {\n uuid id PK\n uuid tower_id FK\n varchar risk_level\n int active_defects_count\n timestamptz assessed_at\n }\n\n notifications {\n uuid id PK\n uuid user_id FK\n varchar type\n varchar reference_type\n uuid reference_id\n varchar title\n text body\n boolean is_read\n timestamptz sent_at\n }\n\n audit_logs {\n uuid id PK\n uuid user_id FK\n varchar table_name\n uuid record_id\n varchar action_type\n jsonb old_values\n jsonb new_values\n timestamptz created_at\n }\n",
